senses.definition: Ellipsis of butterflies in one's stomach.

quotes.text: And I wish that I could be with you tonight / 'Cause you give me butterflies
quotes.reference: 2001, “Butterflies”, in Invincible, performed by Michael Jackson:

quotes.text: I was apprehensive, feeling butterflies, pissed, the sun cracking the flags.

quotes.text: Trying to ignore his butterflies, he looks down at his watch just about every minute to make sure he has the right time.
quotes.reference: 2007, Jeffrey Brown, Heavens Gate: Revelations, page 70:

quotes.text: I should be over all the butterflies / But I'm into you

quotes.text: I'm getting butterflies, like what the hell? / When I'm still feeling right all by myself
Attraction depends on several factors, including mystery and spontaneity—especially early on in the relationship. It’s what keeps those butterflies and the desire for more connection alive.
